subject: Pricing and model list for Hosted API — per-1M token rates?
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-analytics.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick pricing question — per-1M token rates and model list

Hi Tessa,

We're evaluating Redwood's hosted API for a customer-facing conversational product. Before we schedule a call, can you send your standard per-1M token pricing (separate input vs output if applicable) and a short list of models that are generally available on the hosted tier? A couple of specifics that would help:

- Our initial pilot will be ~5M tokens/month (mostly chat: 70% output heavy), scaling to ~30–50M within 6 months if things look good.
- Do you publish input vs output rates or just a per-token flat rate? Any nuance for streaming?
- Do you offer volume discounts or price breaks at ranges (e.g., 10M / 50M / 100M)?
- Any free trial credits or short-term promo pricing for pilots?

If it's easier, feel free to paste a short table in your reply — we just need enough to plug into our procurement spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform
Acme Analytics
liam.oconnor@acme-analytics.com

--
Acme Analytics: building conversational analytics for retail platforms
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick pricing question — per-1M token rates and model list

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask. Below is our standard hosted API baseline (list price) expressed per 1M tokens. Input = tokens sent in requests; Output = tokens returned by generation. Streaming counts output tokens as they are emitted.

Baseline hosted API (list):
- redwood-1-small: input $0.60 / 1M, output $0.90 / 1M
- redwood-1-medium: input $1.20 / 1M, output $1.80 / 1M
- redwood-1-large: input $2.80 / 1M, output $3.75 / 1M
- open-llama-13b: input $1.00 / 1M, output $1.50 / 1M
- falcon-40b-instruct: input $3.20 / 1M, output $4.50 / 1M
- embeddings (text-embed-ada-like): $1.75 / 1M embedding units

Volume discount guidance (hosted API):
- 0–10M/month: list pricing
- 10M–50M/month: eligible for 5–12% off list (sliding scale)
- 50M–200M/month: eligible for 12–25% off list (requires review)
- >200M/month: enterprise pricing / reserved capacity options with deeper discounts and potential price-locks

Quick notes:
- Pricing above is for the hosted tier (shared capacity). Dedicated/reserved capacity has separate committed pricing and can be structured with 12-month price locks and SLAs.
- We bill input and output tokens separately; for chat flows we recommend analyzing the distribution (your 70% output-heavy note) to estimate cost. Streaming doesn't change per-token math, but short-latency settings can increase output token counts due to shorter, more frequent responses.
- We offer pilot credits for qualified pilots (email to sales + product sample).

I attached our concise ratecard (PDF) and a draft SOW for pilots — that'll give you the same numbers in a downloadable table. If you'd like, I can put Ben (Sales Manager) and Aditya (pricing lead) on the thread to discuss pilot discounts or a demo of cost projection tooling.

Would you be available for a 30-min call this week? Here is a booking link: https://calendly.com/redwood-sales/30min

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123
E: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai

Thanks Tessa — that helps a lot. Two quick clarifications from procurement and engineering: 

1) Token counting: do you include system and assistant messages as input tokens for chat API billing? For multi-turn sessions with role tokens and long contexts we want to be sure our estimates are correct.
2) For a pilot at ~5M tokens/month with a view to 30–50M in six months, what discount would you reasonably offer without requiring a reserved capacity commitment? Our procurement prefers a simple % off list that we can put into a PO.

Also looping in Marta from procurement (marta.ruiz@acme-analytics.com) — she may have contract/PO questions if we proceed.

—Liam
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick pricing question — per-1M token rates and model list

Hi Liam / Marta — looping in Ben (sales manager) and Aditya (pricing) to confirm what we can offer for a pilot-first engagement.

To answer the token-count question: yes, system and assistant messages are billed as input tokens when they are sent in the request. The only free tokens we provide are very short prefixes for certain specialized endpoints (rare) — otherwise count everything you send as input. We can help you run a short cost-projection using a sample of your chat logs so you have an accurate monthly estimate.

Prelim commercial suggestion: for a 5M pilot with clear intent to scale to 30–50M within 6 months, we typically offer a short-term pilot discount of ~10% off list for the pilot term (1–3 months) and then a graduated committed discount if you move to a monthly commit (examples below). Ben / Aditya — can you confirm if we can make a formal 10% pilot concession and outline the 3-tier commit pricing we discussed?

Thanks,
Tessa
